initialization: Convert preserved repaired_200 weights to safetensors, verify every tensor and codec unchanged, then ketos train --load converted --resize new. Adapt output alphabet to training EVA characters; do not resume old optimizer/epoch state.
permuted_control: Seeded cyclic assignment within training folio and exact reference length; preserve character inventory and word-length distribution. Development labels remain unchanged. Count text changes explicitly, since duplicate words may retain the same text.
model_selection: Last checkpoint at zero-based epoch199 for both variants. Training-only monitor; no checkpoint or parameter selection by development scores.
metric: Micro Levenshtein error per conventional EVA character in word crops, with exact-word fraction as secondary. Not directly comparable with previous Boxer-unit73.8197% error.
baselines: nearest image using fixed previous feature definition and true training labels
most frequent training character repeated to training median word length
scope: Previously explored physical leaves3 and4, candidate source EVA references without new independent expert review. Warm-start weights previously trained only on leaf3. Development recognition experiment, not a confirmatory manuscript benchmark or translation.
